mapper.select: SELECT noti_id::TEXT AS row_id, noti_type, content, link_url, read_yn, TO_CHAR(reg_dt, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI') AS reg_dt FROM t_notification WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY noti_id DESC LIMIT 30
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_notification WHERE use_yn = 'Y' AND user_id = #{userId} AND read_yn = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_notification (user_id, noti_type, content, link_url, read_yn, use_yn, reg_id, upd_id, reg_dt, upd_dt, reg_ip, upd_ip) VALUES (#{userId}, #{notiType}, #{content}, #{linkUrl}, 'N', 'Y', #{regId}, #{updId}, NOW(), NOW(), #{regIp}, #{updIp})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_notification SET read_yn = 'Y', upd_dt = NOW() WHERE noti_id = #{rowId}::integer AND user_id = #{userId}
UPDATE t_notification SET read_yn = 'Y', upd_dt = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND read_yn = 'N'
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(s.noti_apply, 'Y') AS noti_apply, COALESCE(s.noti_comment, 'Y') AS noti_comment, COALESCE(s.noti_message, 'Y') AS noti_message, COALESCE(s.noti_review, 'Y') AS noti_review FROM (SELECT 1) d LEFT JOIN t_noti_setting s ON s.user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_noti_setting (user_id, noti_apply, noti_comment, noti_message, noti_review, upd_dt) VALUES (#{userId}, COALESCE(NULLIF(#{notiApply}, ''), 'Y'), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{notiComment}, ''), 'Y'), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{notiMessage}, ''), 'Y'), COALESCE(NULLIF(#{notiReview}, ''), 'Y'), NOW()) ON CONFLICT (user_id) DO UPDATE SET noti_apply = EXCLUDED.noti_apply, noti_comment = EXCLUDED.noti_comment, noti_message = EXCLUDED.noti_message, noti_review = EXCLUDED.noti_review, upd_dt = NOW()
